verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a public API that users or agents can call to drive Khoj. The Ollama, LiteLLM and API-key docs describe Khoj consuming external model APIs, not exposing its own. The client apps (Emacs, Obsidian, desktop, WhatsApp) are not a documented public API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt at the docs site.
